questions.stem: Which service is a managed message queue that decouples the components of an application?

options.rationale: SNS pushes messages to subscribers rather than queuing them.
EventBridge routes events to targets using rules.
SQS stores messages until consumers process them, decoupling producers and consumers.
SES sends email.

questions.explanation: SQS is pull-based queuing; SNS is push-based publish/subscribe.

questions.stem: Which service sends a message to many subscribers at once, such as email addresses, SMS numbers and HTTP endpoints, using publish/subscribe?

options.rationale: Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) queues messages for consumers to pull.
Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) sends email at scale but is not publish/subscribe fan-out.
Connect is a contact center service.
Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) is a managed publish/subscribe messaging service.

questions.explanation: The clue is one message to many kinds of subscribers: SNS pushes to every subscriber of a topic, while SQS holds messages until a consumer pulls them.

questions.stem: Which serverless service routes events from AWS services, SaaS applications and custom applications to targets based on rules?

options.rationale: EventBridge is a serverless event bus that routes events to targets using rules.
SQS queues messages but does not route events by rules.
SES sends email.
SNS pushes messages published to a topic out to that topic's subscribers.

questions.explanation: The clue is routing events from many sources by rules: EventBridge is an event bus, while SNS fans out messages that are published to a topic.

questions.stem: Which service sends marketing and transactional email at scale?

options.rationale: Connect runs cloud contact centers.
SES is a cloud email service for transactional and marketing messages.
SNS sends notifications to topic subscribers; it is not an email service for campaigns and receipts.
WorkSpaces provides virtual desktops.

questions.explanation: The clue is marketing and transactional email: SES is built for sending email from applications, while SNS sends short notifications to the subscribers of a topic.

questions.stem: Which service lets a company set up a cloud-based contact center for customer service?

options.rationale: SES sends email.
Lex builds chatbots, which can be used inside Connect but is not a contact center.
Connect is an omnichannel cloud contact center.
WorkSpaces provides virtual desktops.

questions.explanation: The clue is a contact center: Connect runs the whole customer service operation, and a Lex chatbot can be one part of it.

questions.stem: Which service provides full virtual desktops that employees can use from almost any device?

options.rationale: AppStream 2.0 streams individual desktop applications rather than full desktops.
WorkSpaces Secure Browser gives access to websites and SaaS apps, not a whole desktop.
Amplify builds and hosts web and mobile apps.
WorkSpaces provides managed cloud desktops.

questions.explanation: The clue is a full desktop: WorkSpaces gives each user a cloud desktop, while AppStream 2.0 streams single applications and WorkSpaces Secure Browser covers web access.

questions.stem: Which service helps front-end web and mobile developers build, deploy and host full-stack applications on AWS?

options.rationale: Amplify provides tools and hosting for full-stack web and mobile apps.
API Gateway creates and manages APIs, one part of an app's back end.
CodeBuild compiles and tests code.
Connect is a contact center service.

questions.explanation: The clue is front-end web and mobile developers who also need hosting: Amplify covers building, deploying and hosting the app, while API Gateway provides only the APIs.

questions.stem: Which service connects IoT devices to the AWS Cloud so they can securely interact with cloud applications?

options.rationale: Kinesis collects and processes streaming data but does not manage device connections.
IoT Core connects IoT devices to other devices and AWS cloud services.
Connect is a contact center.
Amplify builds web and mobile apps.

questions.explanation: The clue is connecting devices: IoT Core is the managed entry point for IoT devices, while Kinesis processes streams of data once they arrive.

questions.stem: Which service automates the build, test and deploy stages of a software release process?

options.rationale: CodeBuild compiles and tests code as one stage.
CloudFormation provisions infrastructure from templates; it does not run a release pipeline.
CodePipeline is a continuous delivery service that automates the stages of a release.
X-Ray traces requests in running applications.

questions.explanation: The clue is the whole release process across stages: CodePipeline orchestrates the stages, while CodeBuild handles the build-and-test step inside them.

questions.stem: Which service helps developers trace requests through a distributed application to find performance bottlenecks?

options.rationale: CloudTrail records actions taken in an AWS account, not requests moving through an application.
CodePipeline automates software releases.
CodeBuild compiles and tests code.
X-Ray traces requests as they travel through an application and its downstream services.

questions.explanation: The clue is tracing application requests to find bottlenecks: X-Ray maps where time is spent, while CloudTrail records who did what in the AWS account.

questions.stem: Which TWO services help developers build, release or troubleshoot applications? (Choose TWO.)

options.rationale: Connect is a business application for contact centers.
SES is a business application for sending email.
CodePipeline automates the stages of a software release.
WorkSpaces is end-user computing that provides virtual desktops.
X-Ray traces requests to help troubleshoot running applications.

questions.explanation: The developer tools here are AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodePipeline and AWS X-Ray; Connect and SES are business applications and WorkSpaces is end-user computing.

questions.stem: A company wants to open a case with AWS to get help with a technical issue in its account. Which AWS offering provides this?

options.rationale: Trusted Advisor inspects the account and recommends ways to save money and improve security and performance; it does not handle cases.
The Health Dashboard shows AWS events and planned changes that can affect your resources.
AWS Support gives access to customer service and, with a paid plan, to technical support from AWS experts.
Marketplace is a catalog for finding and buying third-party software.

questions.explanation: The clue is opening a case: AWS Support handles cases through the Support Center, while Trusted Advisor gives automated recommendations without anyone working an issue.

questions.stem: A company wants employees to run a desktop design application from a web browser without installing it and without giving each employee a full virtual desktop. Which service should it use?

options.rationale: WorkSpaces provides full cloud desktops, which is more than the company needs.
AppStream 2.0 is a fully managed service that streams desktop applications to users.
WorkSpaces Secure Browser gives access to websites and SaaS apps, not installed desktop applications.
Amplify builds and hosts new web and mobile apps; it does not stream existing desktop applications.

questions.explanation: The clue is streaming one desktop application without a full desktop: AppStream 2.0 streams applications, while WorkSpaces delivers an entire virtual desktop.

questions.stem: What does Amazon WorkSpaces Secure Browser provide?

options.text: A full cloud desktop for each user
options.rationale: Full cloud desktops are what Amazon WorkSpaces provides.
Streaming desktop applications is what Amazon AppStream 2.0 does.

options.text: Isolated browsing of private websites and SaaS apps
options.rationale: Secure Browser runs browsing sessions in AWS, so users reach private websites and SaaS apps while company data stays off their devices.

options.text: An encrypted VPN tunnel from each user's laptop into a VPC
options.rationale: An encrypted tunnel from a user's device into a VPC is what AWS Client VPN provides.

questions.explanation: Secure Browser is about web access: browsing runs in AWS and only the display reaches the user's own browser, unlike WorkSpaces (whole desktops) and AppStream 2.0 (desktop applications).

questions.stem: Which fully managed service compiles source code, runs tests and produces software packages that are ready to deploy?

options.rationale: CodePipeline automates the stages of a release process and can call CodeBuild for its build stage.
CodeBuild is a managed build service, so there are no build servers to run.
X-Ray traces requests in a running application.
CloudFormation provisions infrastructure from templates.

questions.explanation: The clue is compiling and testing code: CodeBuild does the build step itself, while CodePipeline connects build, test and deploy steps into one release workflow.
